name: news-portal
description: Meridian News monorepo — run the Strapi CMS and Next.js frontend together

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/write-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n cms,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:fresh: npm run build:cms && npm run dev
